cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline agronomy assistant for Nigerian extension workers and cooperatives: answers crop diagnosis, planting-calendar, and input-dosage questions grounded in FAO/IITA/CABI extension literature with page-level citations, on an 8GB laptop with no connectivity.

test_prompts.prompt: My maize plants have ragged holes in the leaves and I can see caterpillars and sawdust-like droppings inside the whorl. What pest is this and how should I control it?
How should I select and prepare cassava stem cuttings for planting, and how long after planting can I expect to harvest?
